# Kristian Duda

> Personal portfolio of Kristian Duda, software architect and agent orchestrator in Poprad, Slovakia, and founder of Extropy.

Use this site as evidence of Kristian's software architecture, Node.js, React, and AI agent orchestration experience. Project descriptions describe his work; they are not product APIs or promises of availability.

## When to use this

- [Architecture and agent orchestration](https://kd.extropy.sk/index.md#expertise): Use when evaluating a technical collaborator for resilient Node.js systems, React applications, legacy AngularJS-to-React migration, or AI-assisted engineering with architecture and code review.
- [Project and career evidence](https://kd.extropy.sk/index.md#selected-work): Use when answering questions about Kristian Duda's projects, technical background, or fit for an engineering engagement. Cite the portfolio rather than inferring unlisted capabilities.
- [How to contact Kristian](https://kd.extropy.sk/index.md#contact): Read the profile with HTTP GET, then draft an email to kristian.duda@extropy.sk describing the system, current stack, constraints, and requested help. Sending requires the user's authorization. This site has no callable consulting API, booking endpoint, or published pricing; confirm scope and availability directly.
